claim: Profile before optimising: time hooks by the lines one call takes, count calls and cache misses per update, and require one timing row per hook; guessed costs are often wrong.

evidence.text: No hot spot existed (largest routine 13%); profile before tuning.
Profile a hook by lines one call takes; build at 257 to 297 lines a call was hidden by per-update hook times.
Image cache misses cost 38 ms against 0.1; count them per update.
A hook run for every object cost about 7% against 2-6% for hooks that switch speed; bookkeeping and attribute writes were the next costs.
Profile complete hooks before assigning cost to large copies.
Require one timing row per completed hook so an empty list cannot look like success.
